arcs.title: Flashpoint
arcs.description: Barry Allen travels back in time to save his mother, but his intervention creates a radically altered world on the brink of catastrophe. In this timeline, Hal Jordan’s life takes a very different path, while Abin Sur’s role on Earth becomes central to the Green Lantern-related tie-ins.

series.title: Flashpoint: Abin Sur – The Green Lantern

arcs.title: Twilight of the Guardians
arcs.description: The Guardians’ secretive plans bring them into conflict with the Controllers, threatening to destabilize the balance of power across the universe. Hal Jordan and his allies are drawn into the struggle as old cosmic rivalries return and the Corps faces difficult choices about who should guide its future.

series.title: Hal Jordan and the Green Lantern Corps

arcs.title: Last Charge
arcs.description: As the series approaches its conclusion, Hal Jordan and the Green Lantern Corps face a final wave of threats that tests their resolve and unity. The Lanterns must stand together through a decisive confrontation, bringing this chapter of their adventures to a close.

series.title: Hal Jordan and the Green Lantern Corps

arcs.title: Sinestro
arcs.description: After losing his Green Lantern status, Hal Jordan is forced to work with Sinestro, who has unexpectedly been given a ring again. Their uneasy alliance takes them to Korugar, where Sinestro hopes to free his homeworld from the rule of the Sinestro Corps—and Hal must decide how far he can trust his former enemy.

arcs.title: The Secret of the Indigo Tribe
arcs.description: Hal Jordan and Sinestro investigate the mysterious Indigo Tribe and discover that its origins are tied to Abin Sur and a troubling chapter of the Corps’ past. As the investigation unfolds, the Indigo Tribe’s unusual methods and hidden purpose force Hal and Sinestro to reconsider what they know about compassion, redemption, and the emotional spectrum.

arcs.title: The Revenge of Black Hand
arcs.description: Black Hand returns after the Indigo Tribe’s intervention, bringing death and the Black Lantern legacy back into Hal Jordan and Sinestro’s lives. Their attempt to contain the threat leads to a dangerous confrontation, while the Guardians and other Lanterns become increasingly entangled in the consequences.
